        enabled once the name is edited, and return to disabled after Discard
        reverts the edit.

Name: test_yaml_content_reflects_pipeline

Name: test_code_node_configuration_and_persistence
Description: Configure a Code node's CODE/Input/Output fields; verify they persist through Save + reload.

Name: test_attach_files_in_chat
Description: Attach a file in the pipeline's embedded chat; pipeline processes it without error.

Description: A Code node calling elitea_client.get_user_data() writes the authenticated user's data into a state variable.

Description: Code node reads a custom state variable via elitea_state.get(...) and writes a processed value into another.

Description: Saved chat starter renders as a clickable chip that pre-fills the chat input.

Description: Configure a Decision node's fields; verify they + their edges persist through Save + reload.

Description:
Deleting the middle node (Code 1) removes it + both its edges; LLM 1
    and END remain; the deletion persists after Save + reload.

Name: test_code_node_input_filtering_selective_state_access
Description: A Code node's elitea_state only exposes vars listed in its own input:, excluding others set earlier.

Name: test_create_pipeline_full_details_persist_after_reload
Description: Create a pipeline with all fields populated; verify persistence after reload.

Name: test_three_dot_menu_lists_items
Description: PIPE-028: The three-dot menu should contain expected items.

Name: test_canvas_control_panel_zoom_out_interactivity_cards_size_and_auto_arrange
Description:
Extends the ELITEA-2019 coverage above with the case's remaining
    control-panel buttons: visibility of all 6 buttons, Zoom Out (the
    pre-existing `zoom_out_canvas()` method was never exercised by any
    test before this), Toggle Interactivity (lock/unlock node dragging),
    Toggle cards size (compact/expanded node height, exact round trip), and
    Auto-arrange (deterministic layout — a dragged-away node returns to its
    exact original position).

Name: test_attachments_toggle_persists_across_save_and_reload
Description:
Attachments MODULES toggle + attach-button state survive Save + reload, both directions.

    ELITEA-2059's own test proves the ON-direction, live/unsaved causal link
    (toggle -> attach button, instant, no Save needed). This test proves the
    stronger, Save-gated claim ELITEA-2066's case asks for: after Save and a
    hard page reload, the toggle AND the attach button still reflect the
    persisted state — in both the enable and disable direction.

Name: test_discard_reverts_name_change
Description: PIPE-022: Edit name, click Discard, and verify original name restored.

Name: test_make_node_entrypoint
Description: PIPE-024: Set a node as entrypoint via the three-dot menu.

Name: test_flow_yaml_round_trip
Description: PIPE-021: Toggle Flow → YAML → Flow preserves the canvas.

Name: test_create_pipeline_version_save_list_switch_preserves_canvas_state
Description:
Save As Version creates 'v1_test' with the LLM node preserved;
    switching to 'base' shows the original (node-less) topology; switching
    back to 'v1_test' restores the LLM node — each version's canvas state is
    independently preserved with no cross-version leakage.

Name: test_add_node_menu_lists_types_adds_node_and_dismisses
Description:
Add Node menu lists exactly 11 types in order; LLM selection adds a
    node with config visible; Escape dismisses without adding a node.

Name: test_code_node_return_dict_multiple_state_vars

Name: test_yaml_view_toggle
Description: PIPE-019: Switch to YAML view and verify the editor is visible.

Name: test_decision_node_routes_execution_to_correct_branch
Description: Decision node classifies chat input and routes execution to the matching branch; config persists.

Name: test_collapse_and_expand_left_configuration_panel
Description:
Collapsing the left configuration panel shrinks it and unmounts its
    sections while the canvas grows; expanding it again restores the exact
    original width and remounts every section.
